title: Blackwood Salt E-liquid – Blue Diamond 30ml
description:
Description
Finally, a menthol tobacco for the true connoisseur. Combining a rich light tobacco with a smooth cooling menthol in a perfect blend.
30ml Bottle
50% VG 50% PG
Introducing Bold 50!
In response to the new nicotine cap, Blackwood is now offering a unique hybrid nicotine blend crafted to provide the throat hit you know and love from the original 50mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, but are only 20mg/ml.
